feature:feature:exterminator:bonus-profi.description: You gain proficiency with medium armor and martial weapons.

feature:feature:exterminator:trinkets.description: Consecrated Whetstone: as a bonus action, cast magic weapon once with no spell slot or components. Gilded Dragon Scale: as a bonus action, gain resistance to a damage type of your choice for 1 minute. Wyverntooth Necklace: after hitting with a melee weapon attack, use a bonus action to add 2d8 poison damage.

feature:feature:monster-slayer.description: When you take the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Uses equal your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1), restored on a short or long rest.

feature:feature:silvered-edge.description: A creature you damage with a weapon attack can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. A creature you drop to 0 hit points can't rise as undead or be revived by anything short of wish for 7 days.

feature:feature:killer-instinct.description: You can use Exploit Weakness twice per turn, but not twice against the same target.

feature:feature:inquisitor:bonus-profici.description: You gain proficiency with medium armor.

feature:feature:exorcist-s-doctrines.description: You gain proficiency in Religion and double your proficiency bonus on checks using it.

feature:feature:inquisitor:trinkets.description: Each trinket use takes a bonus action. Alabaster Balm: cast lesser restoration once with no spell slot or components. Hallowed Chalice: create one flask of holy water that turns ordinary after 24 hours; the chalice works five times before it is spent. Reliquary of Doubt: cast detect thoughts once with no spell slot or components, sensing only thoughts tied to negative emotions such as guilt, regret, or fear.

feature:feature:inquisitor:divine-strike.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, you can add 1d6 radiant damage.

feature:feature:rote-piety.description: You can use Opportunistic Piety three times, regaining all uses on a short or long rest.

feature:feature:excommunication.description: As an action, mark a creature you can see within 60 feet; it must succeed on a Constitution or Wisdom save (your choice) or be marked for 1 minute. A marked creature can't regain hit points or have advantage on attack rolls or ability checks, and it takes 2d6 radiant damage each time it takes an action. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:foretelling.description: After each long rest, roll two d20s and record them. Before an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw by you or a creature you can see, you can swap in a foretold roll (once per turn, each roll used once). As an action you can spend a Rushed Incantation use to add another foretold roll, holding at most three; unused rolls vanish when you finish a long rest.

feature:feature:medium:trinkets.description: Dead Ringer: as an action, cast speak with dead once with no spell slot or components, asking only one question. Heptagonal Spectacles: as a bonus action, cast see invisibility once with no spell slot or components. Lucent Mirror: as a bonus action, partly enter the Ethereal Plane for up to 1 minute, moving through creatures and objects as difficult terrain (1d10 force damage if you end your turn inside one) and resisting all damage; the effect ends once you take damage.

feature:feature:forewarning-presence.description: Reroll one of your attack rolls or ability checks and keep the new result. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:whispers-from-beyond.description: Once per long rest, the GM gives you a one-word hint about your best course of action, a promising lead, or similar guidance.

feature:feature:third-eye.description: Once per long rest, cast true seeing as a bonus action with no spell slot or components.

feature:feature:occultist:trinket.description: Rune Keeper's Eyeglass: as a bonus action, you can read all writing for 1 hour.

feature:feature:occultist:pact-magic.description: You learn two warlock cantrips (a third at 10th level) and two 1st-level warlock spells, learning more per the Occultist Spellcasting table; all slots share one level and return on a short or long rest. Slots: 1 at 3rd-4th (1st level), 2 at 5th-6th (1st), 2 at 7th-12th (2nd), 2 at 13th-18th (3rd), 2 at 19th-20th (4th). Spells known: 2 at 3rd, rising by one every two levels to 10 at 19th, and 11 at 20th; each must be of your slot level or lower, and you can swap one known spell each time you gain an investigator level. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability, using your investigator save DC and attack bonus.

feature:feature:eldritch-ruin.description: When you use Exploit Weakness, you can give up its extra damage to cast a cantrip as a bonus action.

feature:feature:eyes-of-another-world.description: You see invisible creatures and objects and those on the Ethereal Plane, perceive the true form of shapechangers and magically altered creatures, and instantly know if a creature you can see is possessed.

feature:feature:maleficium.description: When you use Exploit Weakness on a creature, you can cast bestow curse on it as a bonus action with no spell slot or components, and it saves with disadvantage. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:bravado.description: You gain proficiency in Deception and double your proficiency bonus on checks using it.

feature:feature:spy:trinkets.description: Each trinket use takes a bonus action. Glass Dust: become invisible until the start of your next turn, ending early if you take damage. Horn-Rimmed Glasses: cast disguise self once with no spell slot or components. Martini Glass: cast charm person once with no spell slot or components.

feature:feature:cloak-and-dagger.description: Attacks against a creature that is surprised or hasn't yet acted in combat treat your weapon's damage dice as rolling their maximum.

feature:feature:shaken-not-stirred.description: When you fail a Charisma (Deception) or Charisma (Persuasion) check, reroll it and use the new result. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:body-double.description: When you drop a Humanoid to 0 hit points, use your reaction to take on its appearance as with disguise self, while its body and all physical evidence of its death turn invisible for 8 hours. Alternatively, use an action on a Humanoid corpse dead no more than 24 hours for the same effect. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:feral-trance.description: As a bonus action, enter a trance for 1 minute: advantage on Strength checks and saves, +10 feet walking speed, advantage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks against a creature you have marked, but attacks against you have advantage. It ends early if you fall unconscious or end a turn without having attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since your last turn, and you can end it as a bonus action. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:predator-s-scent.description: Your marks can last up to 24 hours, and while a creature is marked you know its direction and distance as long as it is on your plane.

feature:feature:bloodwrath-guardian:evas.description: When an effect lets you make a Dexterity save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

feature:feature:form-of-the-primal-beast.description: Once per long rest, as an action, transform for 1 minute: you get all Feral Trance benefits and 40 temporary hit points, and melee weapon hits can inflict bleeding wounds (not on Constructs, Oozes, or Undead). A creature loses 1d8 hit points at the start of each of its turns per wound and can't regain hit points while bleeding, unless it spends an action to stop all its bleeding; it can carry wounds up to your proficiency bonus.

feature:feature:battle-tactics.description: You have battle dice that recharge on a short or long rest or when you roll initiative: 2d8 at 3rd level, 3d8 at 7th, 3d10 at 13th, 4d10 at 19th. Once per turn, spend one to perform a maneuver; maneuver save DC is 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). Maneuvers: Bull Rush (after moving 10+ feet straight and making a melee weapon attack, bonus action to add the die to a shove's Athletics check, then knock prone or push up to 10 feet); Bulwark (after a melee hit, bonus action; reduce the next damage that creature deals you before your next turn by the die roll); Cleave (once per turn after dropping a hostile creature to 0 or scoring a melee weapon critical, move up to 15 feet and make another melee weapon attack in the same action, adding the die to damage on a hit); Heel-Cutter (add the die to an opportunity attack roll, and the target must pass a Strength save or have speed 0 until the end of its turn); Reckless Assault (gain advantage on the attack, but attacks against you have advantage until your next turn); Staggering Strike (bonus action with a weapon attack against a Large or smaller creature; on a hit it must pass a Constitution save or be incapacitated until the start of your next turn).

feature:feature:grey-watchman:hold-the-l.description: When you use Warden's Grasp, one other creature you choose in the area gains +1 to AC and saving throws until the start of your next turn while it stays in the area.

feature:feature:fortification-expert.description: You have advantage on checks to build fortifications, find weak points or entrances in walls and defenses, or climb built walls. Three-quarters cover counts as total cover for you.

feature:feature:mettle.description: When an effect lets you make a Constitution save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

feature:feature:unbreakable-sentinel.description: Once per long rest, as an action, gain for 1 minute: +2 AC, a regained battle die each time you hit a creature you have marked, and one extra reaction per round (still at most one per turn).

feature:feature:darkvision.description: You gain darkvision 60 feet, or extend existing darkvision by 30 feet. From 13th level, you can see through magical darkness too.

feature:feature:nightgaunt:marked-for-de.description: If a melee weapon attack against a creature you have marked deals more damage than its remaining hit points, it drops to 0 hit points.

feature:feature:undead-empathy.description: An Undead that targets you with an attack must first make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier); on a failure the attack misses, and if its Intelligence is 4 or less it is friendly to you and your allies for 1 minute.

feature:feature:gravelord.description: Once per long rest, as an action, take on undeath for 1 minute: immunity to poison damage and the poisoned condition; Undying usable three times per long rest instead of once; and once per turn, when your melee weapon attack damages a hostile creature, add 4d6 necrotic damage and gain that much temporary hit points until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:soulblood-shaman:spellca.description: You learn two druid cantrips (a third at 10th level) and know three 1st-level druid spells, two of which must be evocation or transmutation. Later spells must be evocation or transmutation except those gained at 8th, 14th, and 20th level, which can be any school; you can swap one known spell per warden level under the same rule. Slots return on a long rest; Wisdom is your spellcasting ability (save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier; attack modifier proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier). Spells known: 3 at 3rd, 4 at 4th-6th, 5 at 7th, 6 at 8th-9th, 7 at 10th, 8 at 11th-12th, 9 at 13th, 10 at 14th-15th, 11 at 16th-18th, 12 at 19th, 13 at 20th. Slots (1st/2nd/3rd/4th): 2 at 3rd; 3 at 4th-6th; 4/2 at 7th-9th; 4/3 at 10th-12th; 4/3/2 at 13th-15th; 4/3/3 at 16th-18th; 4/3/3/1 at 19th-20th.

feature:feature:soulblood.description: When a creature within 5 feet damages you, you can mark it as a reaction.

feature:feature:whispers-of-beyond.description: Spend 1 minute in contemplation when making an Intelligence or Wisdom check to gain advantage, provided your ancestors could plausibly know the answer.

feature:feature:soulblood-shaman:spell-r.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

feature:feature:ethereal-watcher.description: Once per long rest, as an action, become spirit-like for 1 minute: as a bonus action you can turn ethereal as per etherealness; you can use your bonus action to return when you use Warden's Mark or Warden's Grasp, or when you cast a spell on your turn; on returning, creatures you choose within 10 feet take 4d6 force damage; and you can cast your known 1st- and 2nd-level druid spells without spending slots.

feature:feature:roots-of-rock.description: Using Warden's Grasp gives you +2 AC until the start of your next turn. Also, until you move, hostile effects can't shove or push you unless you allow it, you have advantage on Strength saves against being knocked prone, you can't slip or fall from ledges, and you are immune to fly, levitate, and telekinesis.

feature:feature:earthshatter.description: You can use Warden's Grasp as an action instead; each affected creature must pass a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier) or fall prone. Uses equal your Strength modifier (minimum 1), restored on a long rest.

feature:feature:immortal-mountain.description: Once per long rest, as an action, encase yourself in stone for 1 minute: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage you take is reduced by 5, Roots of Rock applies the whole time, and you can leave a 5-foot-wide trail of difficult terrain as you move.

feature:feature:thunderblast.description: When you hit a creature you have marked with a melee weapon attack, creatures you choose within 5 feet of it take 1d8 lightning damage.

feature:feature:flash-from-above.description: While under open sky, you can use an action to produce a harmless but dramatic lightning bolt or thunderclap, even without clouds.

feature:feature:static-burst.description: When you use Warden's Grasp as a bonus action, affected creatures can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:stormlord.description: You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. Once per long rest, as an action, call lightning onto yourself for 1 minute: your flying speed doubles, and you can cast call lightning as a bonus action without a slot (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier), calling later bolts as a bonus action.

feature:feature:green-mark.description: While a creature you have marked is within 30 feet of you, the ground it moves across is difficult terrain.

feature:feature:verdant-skin.description: You gain Stealth proficiency if you lack it. As an action, wrap yourself in vines and leaves; until you move, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in vegetation.

feature:feature:form-of-the-oak-sentinel.description: Once per long rest, as an action, transform for 1 minute: your AC becomes 20 if lower, your melee attacks have 10-foot reach, and you can use Warden's Grasp as an action to make a separate attack against each affected creature.

feature:feature:house-of-bishops:spellca.description: You gain Intelligence-based slot spellcasting from the wizard spell list; slots return on a long rest. You start knowing three 1st-level wizard spells, two of which must be conjuration or evocation, and every later spell must be conjuration or evocation except the ones gained at 8th, 14th, and 20th level. Each warmage level you may swap one known wizard spell for another of a level you have slots for (subject to the same school limit). By warmage level (spells known, slots 1st/2nd/3rd/4th): 3: 3 known, slots 2; 4: 4 known, slots 3; 5: 4 known, slots 3; 6: 4 known, slots 3; 7: 5 known, slots 4/2; 8: 6 known, slots 4/2; 9: 6 known, slots 4/2; 10: 7 known, slots 4/3; 11: 8 known, slots 4/3; 12: 8 known, slots 4/3; 13: 9 known, slots 4/3/2; 14: 10 known, slots 4/3/2; 15: 10 known, slots 4/3/2; 16: 11 known, slots 4/3/3; 17: 11 known, slots 4/3/3; 18: 11 known, slots 4/3/3; 19: 12 known, slots 4/3/3/1; 20: 13 known, slots 4/3/3/1. Warmage Edge applies to your leveled warmage spells as if they were cantrips, except magic missile.

feature:feature:arcane-study.description: Gain proficiency in two of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, or Religion.

feature:feature:mystical-companion.description: You learn find familiar as a ritual, free of your spells known, and can pick an imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite form in addition to the usual forms.

feature:feature:siege-casting.description: Your warmage spells deal double damage to objects and structures. Spells of yours that use a spell attack can reach up to twice their normal range, with disadvantage on the attack beyond normal range.

feature:feature:spell-sculpting.description: When your warmage spell affects creatures you can see, choose up to your Intelligence modifier of them: they automatically succeed on their saves and take no damage where a success would normally halve it.

feature:feature:arcane-dominance.description: As a bonus action, spend spell slots totaling 6 or more levels to recover one expended use of Arcane Surge.

feature:feature:bluff.description: Gain proficiency in Deception and the playing card set (if you lack them), and you can use Intelligence instead of Charisma for Charisma (Deception) checks.

feature:feature:deck-of-fate.description: When you roll initiative, shuffle a standard 52-card deck and draw five. When you target a hostile creature with a damaging warmage spell, you can spend your bonus action to play cards from your hand; if they form an exact hand from the table, one chosen target takes extra damage or you gain an effect (aces count as 1). Hands: Straight (any five in sequence) +12 damage; Flush (five of one suit) +10 damage; Three of a Kind +6 damage; Pair +2 damage; two Hearts, temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier; two Spades, +10 feet speed until the start of your next turn; two Diamonds, +1 AC until the start of your next turn; two Clubs, +1 to saving throws until the start of your next turn. Played cards go to the bottom of the deck and you draw back up to five. Unmatched cards do nothing.

feature:feature:high-stakes.description: On your turn, with no action, put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of the deck, losing 2 hit points per card, then draw back up to five.

feature:feature:dealer-s-choice.description: As a bonus action, gain one effect that the GM picks: resistance to all damage until the end of your next turn; teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet; or vanish into a safe demiplane until the start of your next turn, returning to the spot you left. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:card-reading.description: Once per turn when you draw for Deck of Fate, name a suit and look at the top card; if you named it correctly, you can also take the Dash, Disengage, or Use an Object action as part of that bonus action.

feature:feature:ace-in-the-hole.description: Whenever you draw cards, draw twice as many, put half on the bottom of the deck, and keep the rest.

feature:feature:house-of-dice:bonus-prof.description: Gain proficiency in Sleight of Hand and the dice set if you lack them.

feature:feature:dice-of-fate.description: You have four Dice of Fate (d6s). Spend one to add it to an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or damage roll; spent dice pass to the GM, who can add one to an NPC or monster roll, after which it returns to you. A long rest restores all your dice whether or not the GM used them. At 7th level you gain two more dice and can add two Dice of Fate to damage rolls of your warmage spells.

feature:feature:chaos-roll.description: As an action, spend two Dice of Fate and roll them (2d6): 2, you cast fireball centered on yourself; 3, your AC drops by 2 until the start of your next turn; 4, you fall prone; 5, every other creature within 60 feet can only babble for 1 minute and can't supply verbal components; 6, a 5-foot-radius sphere of butterflies, insects, or doves heavily obscures a point within 60 feet until the start of your next turn; 7, gain 7 temporary hit points and keep both dice instead of giving them to the GM; 8, you turn invisible (as invisibility) until the end of your next turn; 9, a random object within 60 feet explodes, dealing 3d6 fire damage to one creature the GM chooses and none to you or allies; 10, teleport up to 60 feet to a space you can see, and each creature within 5 feet of the destination makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 force damage; 11, a creature you can see within 60 feet takes 4d6 necrotic damage and you heal that much; 12, you cast lightning bolt and may add Dice of Fate to its damage.

feature:feature:loaded-dice.description: Once per turn when you roll a d6, you can turn it over so the opposite face (7 minus the result) counts instead.

feature:feature:twisted-fate.description: When you make an attack roll or ability check with disadvantage on your turn, you can use a bonus action to spend and roll a Die of Fate: on a 5 you ignore the disadvantage, and on a 6 you have advantage instead.

feature:feature:roll-the-bones.description: When a creature you can see damages you, you can use your reaction and spend two Dice of Fate to make a Chaos Roll.

feature:feature:house-of-dice:steal-luck.description: When you roll initiative, roll a d6 and reclaim that many Dice of Fate from the GM.

feature:feature:house-of-kings:bonus-pro.description: Gain proficiency with medium armor, battleaxes, lances, longswords, tridents, and warhammers.

feature:feature:house-of-kings:battle-ta.description: You fuel stratagems with battle dice: 2d8 at 3rd level, 3d8 at 7th, 3d10 at 13th, and 4d10 at 19th. All spent dice return on a short or long rest or when you roll initiative. You can use one stratagem per turn, and stratagem saves use your spell save DC. Stratagems: Blitz (bonus action after hitting with an attack; an ally who can see or hear you can use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks from your target); Check (bonus action after a hit; the target makes a Charisma save, auto-success if immune to charm, or must use its reaction to move up to half its speed directly away from you); Flash of Brilliance (add the die to an Intelligence or Wisdom check, even after rolling but before the result is known); Gambit (after a hit, the next creature other than you to attack the target adds the die to its attack roll); Mystic Counsel (bonus action, a creature within 30 feet that can hear you can add the die to one save against a spell in the next minute); Stalemate (bonus action after a hit; until the end of its next turn the target can't move willingly unless it first Disengages).

feature:feature:lead-from-the-front.description: You and allies within 120 feet who can see you ignore nonmagical difficult terrain.

feature:feature:tactical-master-2014.description: Friendly creatures within 10 feet of you add your Intelligence modifier to saves against damaging spells and magical effects.

feature:feature:stratagem-checkmate.description: New stratagem: after hitting with a weapon or spell attack, use a bonus action and a battle die so an ally who can see or hear you and is within reach of the target can immediately use its reaction to make one weapon attack or cast an attack-roll cantrip, adding the die to that attack's damage.

feature:feature:grandmaster.description: When you roll initiative, up to your Intelligence modifier of allies who can see or hear you each get a free battle die (no expenditure). Once within 10 minutes, each can add it to an ability check, attack roll, damage roll, or save, deciding after the roll but before the outcome is declared. A creature can hold only one such die at a time.

feature:feature:house-of-knights:bonus-p.description: Gain proficiency with medium armor and martial weapons.

feature:feature:force-breastplate.description: While in light or medium armor or under mage armor, you use your Intelligence modifier in place of Dexterity for your AC.

feature:feature:mystical-weapon.description: You learn force weapon as a bonus cantrip. Whenever you would draw a weapon on your turn, you can instead conjure any simple or martial weapon of force into an empty hand; it counts as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity and disappears if it leaves your hand.

feature:feature:flurry-of-blades.description: When you cast a cantrip that makes multiple spell attacks (such as force weapon or magic daggers), you can use your bonus action to make one more attack with it.

feature:feature:knight-s-ward.description: As a bonus action, gain temporary hit points equal to twice your warmage level for 1 minute. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:tactical-maneuver.description: You can spend all of your movement to teleport up to half your speed to an unoccupied space you can see.

feature:feature:field-of-blades.description: As an action, make separate melee spell attacks against up to five creatures you can see within 30 feet; each hit deals 2d10 + your Intelligence modifier force damage.

feature:feature:intercept-technique.description: With no armor and no shield, your AC is 10 + Dexterity modifier + Intelligence modifier; under mage armor it is 13 + your choice of Dexterity or Intelligence modifier. Using a shield removes this benefit.

feature:feature:hand-to-hand-arcana.description: Your unarmed strikes can use Intelligence for attack and damage rolls, can deal 1d6 in place of their normal damage, and count as melee weapons for warmage spells.

feature:feature:shock-trooper.description: When you make a melee attack on your turn against a creature you can see, you can first lunge up to 15 feet toward it without provoking opportunity attacks, even through the air (you fall after the attack if not on solid ground).

feature:feature:mystical-physicality.description: You can use your Intelligence modifier for Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution checks, and difficult terrain costs you no extra movement.

feature:feature:deflect-energy-2014.description: When a ranged spell attack or ranged weapon attack dealing cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, or radiant damage hits you, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Intelligence modifier + half your warmage level (rounded down).

feature:feature:improved-shock-trooper.description: Your Shock Trooper lunge reaches 30 feet and becomes a teleport that passes through creatures and objects, though you can't end in an occupied space.

feature:feature:flurry-of-spells.description: As an action, spend an Arcane Surge use to cast three different cantrips that each take 1 action or 1 bonus action; Arcane Surge can't apply to them. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:promotion.description: Learn one extra warmage trick that doesn't count against tricks known. Whenever you learn a trick, you can pick ones requiring the House of Bishops, Kings, Knights, or Rooks, provided you meet their other prerequisites.

feature:feature:adaptive-arcanist.description: After each short or long rest, pick a warmage cantrip; you know it (not counted against cantrips known) until you pick another with this feature.

feature:feature:pawn-storm.description: A creature you target with a cantrip can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of the turn, whether or not the cantrip damaged it.

feature:feature:additional-arcane-fighti.description: Choose a second option from Arcane Fighting Style.

feature:feature:opening-move.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to initiative, and when you roll initiative while not surprised you can move up to your speed.

feature:feature:fundamental-mastery.description: Once per turn when rolling damage for a warmage cantrip, treat one damage die as its maximum result.

feature:feature:rook-strike.description: As a bonus action, gain advantage on your next spell attack roll this turn, or give a creature disadvantage on its save against a warmage spell you cast before your turn ends. Recharges on a short or long rest, or when a cantrip of yours drops a creature to 0 hit points.

feature:feature:rasp.description: You can cast knock at will without a spell slot; cast this way it takes 1 minute and makes no sound.

feature:feature:arcane-acrobat.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to every Dexterity check, and when you fall while not incapacitated you can reduce the fall by up to 60 feet for damage purposes.

feature:feature:fleeting-decoy.description: When a creature you can see damages you, you can use your reaction so attacks against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:elusive-step.description: Once you have moved more than 15 feet on your turn, your further movement that turn doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

feature:feature:flash-of-feathers.description: Cast invisibility on yourself only, with no slot or components. While invisible this way your speed doubles, and you can make one attack or cast one warmage cantrip without ending the invisibility. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:black-magic-spells.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st exhume, inflict wounds; 2nd gentle repose, magic weapon; 3rd animate dead, vampiric touch; 4th blight, death ward; 5th cloudkill, contagion.

feature:feature:hex-decay.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Constitution save; on a failure at the start of its next turn it suffers 1d4 necrotic damage and its hit point maximum drops by that amount while the hex lasts, killing it if the maximum reaches 0. Ends at the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:undeath-command.description: The bonus action you use to command your familiar can also command any Undead you control through animate dead or similar magic.

feature:feature:life-tether.description: When a creature you can see damages you, you can use your reaction to split the damage with the sole target of your hex: you take half (rounded down) and it takes the rest. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:black-sacrifice.description: As an action with your familiar within 10 feet, you sacrifice its bond: creatures you choose within 20 feet of it make a Dexterity save against your spell save DC, taking 8d10 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success, and their hit point maximum drops by the necrotic damage taken (dying at 0). The familiar can't be summoned again before your next long rest.

feature:feature:blood-magic-spells.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st hellish rebuke, hollowing curse; 2nd acid arrow, hold person; 3rd ruby-eye curse, vampiric touch; 4th blight, dominate beast; 5th cloudkill, dominate person.

feature:feature:hex-blood-curse.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Constitution save; on a failure, until the end of your next turn, the moment it is both injured and under twice your witch level in hit points, it falls to 0 hit points.

feature:feature:novice-hemomancy.description: A drop of your blood can replace material components that have no listed cost.

feature:feature:arcane-bloodletting.description: When casting a spell with a casting time of 1 action, lose 5 hit points to cast it as a bonus action instead. Uses equal your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), restored on a long rest.

feature:feature:deathseeker.description: You sense the location of any creature within 60 feet that is missing hit points, even when heavily obscured and through most barriers (stopped by a foot of stone, an inch of ordinary metal, a thin lead sheet, or 3 feet of wood or earth). You have advantage on checks to track a creature you or your familiar damaged in the last 24 hours.

feature:feature:hemomantic-recovery.description: Once per day after a short rest, spend Hit Dice to regain spell slots of 5th level or lower: 2 Hit Dice for 1st, 3 for 2nd, 5 for 3rd, 6 for 4th, 7 for 5th.

feature:feature:sanguine.description: Once per round, when your spell hurts a hostile creature that is your hex's only target, you can lose hit points to add 2d8 necrotic damage per 5 hit points lost, up to 6d8.

feature:feature:green-magic-spells.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st entangle, goodberry; 2nd barkskin, locate animals or plants; 3rd conjure animals, plant growth; 4th conjure woodland beings, stoneskin; 5th awaken, tree stride.

feature:feature:hex-elder-tongue.description: As a bonus action, until the end of your next turn you can communicate in a limited way with Beasts and Plants (they can relay simple recent observations) and have advantage on Charisma checks to influence them.

feature:feature:primal-ally.description: Your familiar adds three times your witch level to its hit point maximum instead of twice.

feature:feature:twin-familiar.description: When summoned, your familiar can be split into two identical bodies sharing one hit point pool, acting on consecutive turns. Command one to attack with your bonus action and the other with your action; effects that target or dismiss the familiar affect both.

feature:feature:vital-nourishment.description: When you finish a long rest, plants within 120 feet grow as if a month of ideal conditions passed, and food-bearing plants yield enough to feed six creatures for a day. Up to six creatures you can see gain temporary hit points of half your witch level + Charisma modifier, and you can end one disease or one blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned condition on each.

feature:feature:sacrificial-familiar.description: When a melee attack targets you with your familiar within 5 feet, you can use your reaction to have the attack target the familiar instead. Uses equal your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), restored on a long rest.

feature:feature:purple-magic-spells.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st charm person, silent image; 2nd enthrall, invisibility; 3rd hypnotic pattern, major image; 4th confusion, private sanctum; 5th modify memory, seeming.

feature:feature:hex-hallucination.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save (auto-success if immune to charm); on a failure it takes -1 to attack rolls and ability checks, worsening by 1 at the start of each of its turns to a maximum of -5. Lasts until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:false-authority.description: As an action, everyone who sees you perceives you as an authority figure relevant to them for 1 hour (or until you end it); it doesn't survive physical inspection, and a creature can use its action and an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see through it. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:deceitful-transposition.description: As a bonus action, make two creatures within 60 feet appear to have swapped places, relocating their sounds, smells, and other cues; they don't perceive the illusion. An observer can use its action and an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see the truth. Lasts 1 minute, ending early if either takes damage or a physical interaction exposes it. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:waking-nightmare.description: When a creature fails its save against your Hallucination hex, you can make it treat every creature as an enemy until the hex ends: it picks targets for attacks, spells, and effects at random among creatures in range it can see, and must use its reaction on any opportunity attack offered. Ends after 1 minute. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:red-magic-spells.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st burning hands, magic missile; 2nd acid arrow, scorching ray; 3rd fireball, protection from energy; 4th ice storm, wall of fire; 5th cone of cold, telekinesis.

feature:feature:hex-imperil.description: Action, choose a damage type and one creature you can see within 60 feet, which makes a Constitution save; on a failure its resistance to that type is suppressed through the end of your next turn, and immunity to it is downgraded to resistance.

feature:feature:convolute-energy.description: Casting a spell that deals acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage can grant you resistance to that damage type through the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:invulnerability.description: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to reduce the damage by 50. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:elemental-annihilation.description: When you cast a witch spell dealing acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can spend an additional slot of equal or higher level to deal maximum damage. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:steel-magic-spells.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st heroism, shield; 2nd heat metal, magic weapon; 3rd blink, haste; 4th death ward, freedom of movement; 5th flame strike, telekinesis.

feature:feature:steel-magic:bonus-profic.description: Gain proficiency with martial melee weapons that lack the heavy and special properties.

feature:feature:hex-malevolence.description: As a bonus action, wrap yourself in evil smog until the end of your next turn; damage can't break your concentration on it. While active: AC 12 + Dexterity modifier + Charisma modifier without a shield (usable if better than your armor); use Charisma for attack and damage with melee weapons lacking heavy and special; and a visible creature within 5 feet that damages you can be answered with a melee weapon attack as your reaction.

feature:feature:cackling-killer.description: On a turn you use Cackle, you attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action.

feature:feature:soulsword-familiar.description: As a bonus action, dismiss your familiar into your weapon, wreathing it in green flame; it deals an extra 1d8 fire damage on a hit until you resummon the familiar, which you can't do until a short or long rest.

feature:feature:shrieking-strike.description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon attack, the target makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is frightened of you for up to 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Uses equal your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), restored on a long rest.

feature:feature:tea-magic-spells.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st hideous laughter, sanctuary; 2nd augury, calm emotions; 3rd clairvoyance, sending; 4th divination, private sanctum; 5th legend lore, scrying.

feature:feature:hex-tasseography.description: Action, pick an ally you can see within 60 feet and roll a d20, noting the result. Until the end of your next turn you can substitute that number for one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check the ally makes, chosen before it rolls; the hex then ends.

feature:feature:tea-ceremony.description: During a short or long rest you conjure tea for yourself and allies; each creature that drinks it removes one extra level of exhaustion during that rest.

feature:feature:shapes-and-omens.description: After a long rest, the GM describes a shape in your tea leaves that hints at upcoming events.

feature:feature:herbal-remedy.description: Cast greater restoration without a slot or material components. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:invigorate.description: As a bonus action, you or an ally you can see within 5 feet gains one extra action on its next turn. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:technicolor-magic-spells.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st color spray, speak with animals; 2nd animal messenger, warding bond; 3rd fly, sending; 4th freedom of movement, locate creature; 5th telepathic bond, teleportation circle.

feature:feature:hex-musical-interlude.description: Action, each willing creature within 30 feet that you can see and that can see you gains temporary hit points of half your witch level + Charisma modifier, lasting through the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:animal-friends.description: Advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks to befriend Beasts, using Charisma instead of Wisdom for Small or smaller ones. You can dismiss an adopted Beast pet into an extradimensional space as you would a familiar.

feature:feature:friendship-bracelet.description: As an action, craft a cheap bracelet. You always know the location of a creature wearing one while on the same plane and can aim spells and effects at it without needing sight of it.

feature:feature:positivity.description: When an attacker you can see hits you, your reaction adds to your AC one point per friendly creature within 5 feet of you, possibly causing a miss. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:redemptive-arc.description: When a hostile creature you can see drops to 0 hit points, use your reaction to make it stable and unconscious until it regains hit points; when it wakes, any charm, curse, fright, or possession effect on it ends and it loses one bond or flaw that drove its hostility toward you. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:white-magic-spells.description: Learned craft spells (count as witch spells, not against spells known), by spell level: 1st bless, cure wounds; 2nd lesser restoration, prayer of healing; 3rd beacon of hope, revivify; 4th death ward, guardian of faith; 5th mass cure wounds, raise dead.

feature:feature:hex-remedy.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet regains 1d10 + your witch level hit points; it can't benefit again until it finishes a short or long rest.

feature:feature:talisman-of-protection.description: Spend 1 hour (possible during a short rest) making a talisman; the wearer adds a d4 to all its saving throws. Only one exists at a time; making another makes the old one mundane.

feature:feature:benevolent-surge.description: When you, your familiar, or an ally you can see within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction to have it regain 1d10 + your Charisma modifier hit points. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:witch-s-gift.description: When your spell or hex restores a creature's hit points, it gains +3 AC until the end of your next turn.

actions.description: Up to four other creatures within 60 ft. that can see it have advantage on attack rolls and can't be frightened until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Power of the Dragon Queen
actions.description: One Dragon it can see within 120 ft. makes a DC 18 Cha save (chromatic dragons at disadvantage) or is charmed for 1 hour, treating it as a trusted friend; ends if it or its companions damage the dragon. A success grants immunity for 1 hour.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against effects that turn Undead.

actions.description: Two Chilling Grasp or Arcane Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Chilling Grasp

actions.description: 60-foot cone, DC 17 Dex save; roll a d6 for each creature. 1-2 red: 35 (10d6) radiant and blinded; 3-4 blue: 35 (10d6) necrotic and frightened; 5-6 green: 35 (10d6) force and incapacitated; conditions last until the end of the giant's next turn, and a success halves the damage and avoids the condition.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Breathes air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Claw attacks and one Stinger attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 15 ft.; 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning, and a Huge or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 16). Each of its four claws grapples one target.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 10 ft.; 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing, and the target makes a DC 17 Con save or is poisoned and paralyzed for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end).

actions.name: Water Jet (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: 150-foot line, 10 feet wide, DC 17 Dex save: 27 (6d8) bludgeoning, pushed 30 feet and knocked prone, or half damage only on a success.

traits.name: Alert
traits.description: Can't be surprised; advantage on initiative rolls.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Breathes air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Scrying (Requires Storm Rune)
traits.description: Casts scrying through its crystal ball (save DC 17).

traits.name: Storm Rune
traits.description: A storm rune on a crystal ball embedded in its body grants Tempest Call and Scrying. The ball has AC 17, 50 HP, immunity to necrotic, poison and psychic, and regains all HP each turn, but turns to dust at 0 HP or when the giant dies; it can inscribe a new one on a short or long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Lightning Blade or Lightning Lance attacks.

actions.name: Lightning Blade
actions.description: Melee attack, +15, reach 10 ft.; 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing plus 16 (3d10) lightning.

actions.name: Lightning Lance
actions.description: Ranged attack, +13, range 500 ft.; 39 (5d12 + 7) lightning.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Charisma, save DC 21, +13 to hit, no material components. At will: detect magic, detect thoughts. 1/day each: control water, control weather (as an action), dispel magic, plane shift, sending, time stop.

actions.name: Tempest Call (Requires Storm Rune)
actions.description: Each other creature within 60 feet makes a DC 21 Dex save, 43 (8d8 + 7) cold, lightning or thunder (its choice), half on success.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Breathes air and water.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Claw attack, one Tentacles attack and one Trident attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +14, reach 10 ft.; 18 (3d6 + 8) slashing.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee attack, +14, reach 10 ft.; 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning, and a Large or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 18) and restrained, taking 16 (3d10) psychic at the start of each of its turns; one at a time.

actions.name: Trident
actions.description: Melee attack, +14, reach 10 ft.; 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing, or 21 (3d8 + 8) two-handed, plus 13 (3d8) lightning.

actions.name: Psychic Wave (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Up to three creatures it can see within 90 feet make a DC 21 Int save: 23 (3d10 + 7) psychic and stunned for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end), or half damage only on a success. A creature this kills has its head explode.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.description: Intelligence, save DC 21, no components. At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, mage hand (invisible hand). 1/day each: control water, control weather (as an action), sending.

monster:tempest-spirit.damageResistances: cold, necrotic, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tempest-spirit.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects as difficult terrain; 5 (1d10) force if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.description: Melee attack, +12, reach 10 ft.; 25 (4d8 + 7) lightning.

actions.name: Hailstone
actions.description: Ranged attack, +12, range 90/180 ft.; 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) cold.

actions.name: Death Bolt (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: 120-foot line, 10 feet wide: DC 18 Dex save, 27 (6d8) lightning plus 16 (3d10) necrotic, half on success; either way, the creature's HP maximum drops by the necrotic taken until a long rest (dying at 0).

bonusActions.name: Hailstorm (Recharge 4-6)

actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 10 ft.; 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning; after a 20-foot straight charge, +13 (3d8) bludgeoning and a creature makes a DC 18 Str save or is knocked prone.
